hero.title: Healthcare that reaches every home, every village
hero.subtitle: MediReach brings trusted doctors, medicines, and care to rural communities — in English, Telugu, and Hindi, even on low-connectivity networks.
hero.trust: Secure, role-based access for patients, doctors, pharmacists, and health administrators.

problem.title: Quality care shouldn't depend on where you live
problem.subtitle: Millions in rural communities face long distances, scarce specialists, and unreliable connectivity when they need care most.

items.title: Distance to care
items.description: Traveling hours to the nearest clinic delays treatment and adds cost for families.

items.title: Limited specialists
items.description: Rural areas often lack access to doctors, diagnostics, and timely referrals.

items.title: Unreliable connectivity
items.description: Low-bandwidth networks make digital health tools frustrating and out of reach.

about.title: A trusted bridge between communities and care
about.subtitle: MediReach is a public-health platform designed for rural India, pairing modern telemedicine with the human touch of community health workers.
points: Works offline-first with automatic retry on low-connectivity networks
Fully trilingual in English, Telugu, and Hindi
Role-based access keeps every patient's data private and secure
Built with community health workers and local clinics in mind

services.title: Complete care, close to home
services.subtitle: From booking an appointment to checking medicine availability, MediReach brings the full care journey to your community.

items.title: Appointments
items.description: Book and manage visits with local clinics and doctors, online or offline.

items.title: Teleconsultation
items.description: Talk to a doctor by video or phone, anytime, from your own village.

items.title: Referrals
items.description: Get guided referrals to specialists and higher-level facilities when needed.

items.title: Triage
items.description: Quick, guided assessments help you understand urgency and next steps.

items.title: Diagnostics
items.description: Access lab results and diagnostic services with clear, simple explanations.

items.title: Medicine availability
items.description: Check which medicines are in stock at your local pharmacy before you travel.

privacy.title: Your trust is our priority
privacy.subtitle: We protect your health information with secure, role-based access and clear, fair terms.
privacy.privacyBody: MediReach uses fictional healthcare data for demonstration. Your personal information is protected with secure login, authorized access, and role-based permissions. We never share your data without your consent.
privacy.termsBody: By using MediReach you agree to use the platform responsibly and respect the privacy of others. All healthcare data shown is fictional and for demonstration purposes only.
